title: “Welcome back” after sign-out
description: UI returns to the auth screen when the session ends so users are not left in a stale “guest chat” layout.
content:
“Welcome back” after sign-out

UI returns to the auth screen when the session ends so users are not left in a stale “guest chat” layout.

What this is

When your Kahana session ends, Oasis switches the assistant back to the authentication view instead of leaving you in a guest chat that might show stale limits or errors.

How to use it

  • Sign out from the assistant account menu when you are done on a shared computer.
  • Sign in again to restore cloud features and your IndexedDB chat namespace.
  • If the UI looks stuck, close and reopen the assistant panel once.

Notes and limits

Local training progress or dismissed hints may still exist in browser storage after sign-out.
